karty.priklad: Mae chwedl Rhys a Meinir yn drist iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The legend of Rhys and Meinir is very sad (trist → [d]rist after yn).
karty.mnemo: 'WHAT'LL (CHWEDL) happen next?' – a legend told by the glow of a red-hot stove.

karty.priklad: Cerdda i ar lan y môr fory.
karty.priklad_cs: I'll walk on the seashore tomorrow (glan → [l]an after ar).
karty.mnemo: One GLANce (GLAN) at the shore: the sand is too hot to walk on.

karty.priklad: Mae'r wylan wedi dwyn fy mrechdan i!
karty.priklad_cs: The seagull has stolen my sandwich! (gwylan → [w]ylan after y, feminine; brechdan → [m]rechdan after fy)
karty.mnemo: The seagull WAILS (GWYL-an) and makes off with your chips, dripping ketchup.

karty.priklad: Tarodd mellten y goeden.
karty.priklad_cs: Lightning struck the tree (coeden → [g]oeden after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: MELT 'EN (MELL-ten): the lightning melts the weathervane into red-hot drips.

extra.pozn: mellten = one flash, mellt = lightning (collective); tarodd colloquial, literary trawodd

karty.priklad: Awn ni ar fordaith i'r Caribî.
karty.priklad_cs: We'll go on a cruise to the Caribbean (mordaith → [f]ordaith after ar).
karty.mnemo: môr (sea) + taith (journey): a sea journey where the chef serves tomato soup every single night.

karty.priklad: Ymwelwn ni ag oriel y Louvre.
karty.priklad_cs: We'll visit the Louvre gallery.
karty.mnemo: An ORIEL window (ORIEL) in the gallery throws red light onto a painting of rubies.

karty.priklad: Mae safon y bwyd yn uchel iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The standard of the food is very high.
karty.mnemo: Never SAVE ON (SAF-on) standards: the postman's red van is polished every morning.

karty.priklad: Mae'r ci wedi ffeindio asgwrn mawr.
karty.priklad_cs: The dog has found a big bone.
karty.mnemo: The dog growls 'AS-GRRR-N' (AS-GWRN) over a bone frozen into the ice.

karty.cs_upresneni: in a competition, not a judge in court
karty.priklad: Roedd y beirniad yn hoffi'r côr.
karty.priklad_cs: The judge liked the choir.
karty.mnemo: A judge giving marks at a BARN (BEIRN-iad) dance in a freezing cold barn.

karty.priklad: Mae cyfleusterau da yn y gwersyll.
karty.priklad_cs: There are good facilities at the camp.
karty.mnemo: cyfleus (convenient) + -ter: the campsite has facilities – but the shower is ice-cold.

karty.priklad: Beth dych chi'n (ei) feddwl o gyfnod y Nadolig?
karty.priklad_cs: What do you think of the Christmas period? (cyfnod → [g]yfnod after o)
karty.mnemo: 'COVE, NOD off!' (CYF-NOD) – a long period of time spent snoozing in an icy cove.

sever.priklad: Be dach chi'n (ei) feddwl o gyfnod y Nadolig?
sever.priklad_cs: What do you think of the Christmas period? (cyfnod → [g]yfnod after o)
sever.pozn: north: Be instead of Beth (L9), dach instead of dych (L11)

karty.priklad: Mae'r defnydd o blastig yn broblem fawr.
karty.priklad_cs: The use of plastic is a big problem (plastig → [b]lastig after o; problem → [b]roblem after yn; mawr → [f]awr after the feminine problem).
karty.mnemo: DEFINITELY (DEF-n-ydd) of use: a blue ice scraper is the most useful thing in winter.

extra.pozn: in other contexts also material, fabric (not in the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Does dim rhaid i chi fod yn ddringwr da.
karty.priklad_cs: You don't have to be a good climber (dringwr → [dd]ringwr after yn).
karty.mnemo: dringo (to climb) + -wr (person): a climber on the north face, beard full of icicles.

karty.priklad: Pwy yw'r gwestai ar y rhaglen heno?
karty.priklad_cs: Who's the guest on the programme tonight?
karty.mnemo: gwesty = hotel: the GUEST (GWEST-ai) checks in with a frostbitten blue nose.

extra.pozn: careful: gwestai is also the plural of gwesty (hotels)

sever.priklad: Pwy ydy'r gwestai ar y rhaglen heno?
sever.priklad_cs: Who's the guest on the programme tonight?
sever.pozn: north: ydy instead of yw (by analogy with L5 Beth yw / Be ydy)

karty.priklad: Nofiwn ni yn Llyn Padarn.
karty.priklad_cs: We'll swim in Llyn Padarn.
karty.mnemo: A LLYN (lake) frozen solid: ice fishermen sit round a hole in the middle.

karty.priklad: Ces i farc da yn yr arholiad.
karty.priklad_cs: I got a good mark in the exam (marc → [f]arc after ces i).
karty.mnemo: Same as English: a top mark from a teacher with blue fingers in an unheated classroom.

sever.priklad: Ges i farc da yn yr arholiad.
sever.priklad_cs: I got a good mark in the exam (marc → [f]arc after ges i).
sever.pozn: north: ges i instead of ces i (not in the coursebook)

karty.cs_upresneni: a number of things (how many), not a numeral (= rhif)
karty.priklad: Mae nifer o bobl yn siarad Cymraeg yma.
karty.priklad_cs: A number of people speak Welsh here (pobl → [b]obl after o).
karty.mnemo: NEVER (NIF-er) try to count the number of snowflakes in a blizzard.

extra.rod_pozn: coursebook: m; but often also used as f (nifer fawr o bobl) – to be checked

karty.priklad: Dw i ddim yn prynu bagiau plastig.
karty.priklad_cs: I don't buy plastic bags.
karty.mnemo: Same as English: a blue plastic sledge racing down a frozen hill.

karty.priklad: Mae mynd am dro ar hyd llwybr yr arfordir yn bleser.
karty.priklad_cs: Going for a walk along the coast path is a pleasure (pleser → [b]leser after yn).
karty.mnemo: Same as English: the pleasure of a freezing Boxing Day dip in the sea.

karty.priklad: Mae pryfyn yn fy nghawl i!
karty.priklad_cs: There's a fly in my soup! (cawl → [ngh]awl after fy)
karty.mnemo: PROVE IN (PRYF-yn) court it's a fly – it's frozen in your ice cube!

karty.priklad: Gwelodd Rhys sgerbwd yn y goeden.
karty.priklad_cs: Rhys saw a skeleton in the tree (coeden → [g]oeden after y).
karty.mnemo: A SCARE BOOT (SGER-bwd): the snowplough digs up a skeleton in a ski boot.

karty.priklad: Gwisgodd Meinir ei ffrog sidan hi.
karty.priklad_cs: Meinir wore her silk dress.
karty.mnemo: SID AN' (SID-an) Ann wrap their snowman in a silk scarf.
